feeds.title: Politics NY
feeds.description: In-depth local coverage of politics across the five boroughs of New York City. PoliticsNY is a hyper-local daily news site covering the elected officials and government that serves New York. We are one of the most influential voices of its kind reaching elected officials, those in the halls of government, and the general public passionate about politics.

feeds.title: City & State New York
feeds.description: City & State is the premier media organization dedicated to covering New York's local and state politics and policy. Our in-depth, non-partisan coverage serves New York's leaders every day as a trusted guide to the issues impacting New York. We offer round-the-clock coverage through our award-winning commentary and analysis, weekly publications, daily e-briefs, events, podcast interviews and more.

feeds.title: Empire Center
feeds.description: The Empire Center is an independent, non-partisan, non-profit think tank located in Albany, New York. Their mission is to make New York a better place to live and work by promoting public policy reforms grounded in free-market principles, personal responsibility, and the ideals of effective and accountable government.

feeds.title: Conservative Party of New York State
feeds.description: Avidly advocating for the taxpayers of New York State. Conservative Party has been the voice of the conservative movement in New York State. Get the party insider news and updates. Since 1962, the Conservative Party has been the voice of the conservative movement in New York State. Votes cast on the Conservative Party line have provided the margin of victory for many state-wide, congressional, and local races.

feeds.title: Liberal Party of New York Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1944, the Liberal Party of New York champions candidates with liberal viewpoints. Providing insider news and updates, it serves as a vital platform for advancing progressive agendas and shaping political discourse in the state.

feeds.title: Workers World
feeds.description: Workers World Party, a revolutionary socialist organization, stands against oppression in the U.S. and globally, opposing imperialism. It advocates for socialism, combating capitalism. With branches nationwide, it provides news and analysis via its blog, fostering activism and solidarity.

feeds.title: The Legislative Gazette
feeds.description: The Legislative Gazette is a student-run, online news site covering the politics, policies, and people of the New York State government.

feeds.title: NYC Politics
feeds.description: NYC Politics is the online digital source for New York City Politics. Covers News, polls, events, articles, voter blogs, and more.

feeds.title: Politics and Other Stuff
feeds.description: Author Ken Kruly who is a Political blogger operated Politics and Other Stuff Blog covering political updates and news. Also covers the important issue, statistics; demographics; legislative votes; poll results, and more.

feeds.title: PIX11 News
feeds.description: National politics through New York's Very Own lens. PIX11 News brings you breaking and developing news, weather, traffic, and sports coverage from New York City and across the state.

feeds.title: The New York Times » Politics
feeds.description: The New York Times offers breaking news and analysis on U.S. politics, covering the White House, Congress, and the Supreme Court. As a leading US daily, it provides expert, independent journalism to help readers understand the world through on-the-ground reporting.

feeds.title: New York Post Politics
feeds.description: Your source for breaking news, photos, and videos about New York, sports, business, entertainment, opinion, real estate, culture, fashion, and more. Get the latest politics news, articles, videos, and photos on the New York Post.

feeds.title: News10 ABC Election News
feeds.description: WTEN is an ABC television network affiliate serving Albany, Schenectady, Troy, Saratoga, and surrounding communities. Covers the latest News and Updates in Your Local Election HQ.

feeds.title: THE CITY Politics
feeds.description: THE CITY is an independent, nonprofit newsroom dedicated to hard-hitting reporting that serves the people of New York. Covers political updates and news.

feeds.title: NBC New York » Politics
feeds.description: NBC New York delivers comprehensive coverage of local news, weather, entertainment, and breaking stories, including political updates. Stay informed with the latest on New York's political landscape and other important developments in the region.

feeds.title: amNewYork Politics
feeds.description: All the news you need in a New York minute. Get the latest local stories, political updates, photos, and videos that are important to you, all in one place on am New York.
